description: Batch x402 precheck: up to 10 URLs in one call. Run the full hearth.precheck.v2 check on up to 10 x402 URLs at once ($0.02, i.e. $0.002 each). Pass urls as a comma-separated list (or JSON body {"urls": "a,b"}). Returns one result per URL plus a summary of pay/caution/avoid counts. Example output: {"count":2,"summary":{"pay":2,"caution":0,"avoid":0},"results":[{"url":"https://api.exa.ai/search","verdict":"pay","score":90}]}. Price: $0.02 USDC on Base via x402 (pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]).
